transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

I came in because my talking gets all mixed up. Like I’m trying to explain one thing, and then I’m talking about the keys, and then jail, and then a prayer rug, then chess pieces… and people tell me they can’t follow what I’m saying. I know what I mean at first, but it comes out wrong.
Does this mixed-up talking happen all the time when you speak, or does it come and go?

It comes and goes. It’s not every single time I open my mouth, but when it happens, it gets real mixed up. I’ll start trying to talk about one thing, like the keys, and then I’m suddenly saying something about jail, then a prayer rug, then chess pieces. People look at me like they can’t follow it, and I can tell I’m losing them.
Do you ever hear or see things that other people do not?

Yeah… sometimes I hear a man’s voice. It’ll sound like it’s coming from the vents, or from the mop closet at work. It says my name, or says I ruined everything. It sounds real, like somebody is standing right next to me saying it.
Do you find yourself doing things that don't make sense or having trouble completing tasks?

Yeah. I’ll be trying to do something simple, like mop a floor, and then one little thing pulls me off it. A door closes, or a light starts buzzing, and I’m over checking the window, or touching my keys, or starting some other job. Then the first thing still isn’t done, and I don’t even always notice right away.
Do you feel like these voices or the mixed-up talking are connected to the times when you have trouble completing tasks or doing things that don't make sense?

Yeah, I think they do connect. When I’m sleeping only a few hours, I start getting all these big plans about the buildings, like I need to fix everything or set things up a certain way. Around those same times, I hear that voice from the vents more, and I get sure the hallway lights are warning me about myself. Then I can’t stay on one task, because I’m watching for what the lights mean or listening for the voice.
Do you think the mixed-up talking and trouble completing tasks are the main problems you're experiencing right now?

Yeah, I think the talking is the big thing. I try to explain what’s going on, and it comes out all mixed up. I’ll start talking about the keys, then somehow I’m on the jail, then the prayer rug, then chess pieces. People look at me like they can’t follow it, and I can tell I’m not making sense.
Do you often find yourself behaving in ways that seem unusual or inappropriate to others?

I’m not really sure. I don’t always know how it looks to other people. Sometimes I can tell folks are watching me or acting like I’m being odd, but I don’t know if it’s something I’m doing or if I’m just noticing them.
Do these mixed-up thoughts and hearing voices happen all at once for a while and then stop for a while, or are they spread out over time?

It’s more spread out over time, I think. The voices and that feeling like I’m being watched or marked… that’s been going on about a year and a half now. It might get stronger sometimes, but it hasn’t really just stopped for a long stretch.
Do you have periods where all of these symptoms, like the mixed-up talking and the voices, seem to go away completely?

No, not completely. It’s been going on a long time now… about two years and five months, since after that brief detention over the misunderstanding at the building. It might change some, but I don’t think it ever fully goes away.
Do you have any behaviors that you think are unusual or that others have told you are unusual?

Yeah… I guess when I get that energy, I can’t really sit still. I’ll clean the same hallway over and over, move chairs around for no real reason, make lists, and just keep walking around even when my feet are hurting. People have told me that’s not normal, or they’ll ask why I’m still going.
Do these symptoms, like the mixed-up talking and hearing voices, happen in distinct episodes or are they more continuous over time?

It’s more continuous, I’d say. It’s been going on for about two years and five months now, since after that brief detention from the misunderstanding at the building. It changes some, but it hasn’t felt like separate episodes.
Have you ever had a time when all these symptoms, like the mixed-up talking and the voices, were much worse for a short period, like a few weeks or months?

I’m not really sure. I don’t think of it like it got much worse for just a few weeks or months. It’s more like it’s there, and some days are harder than others, but I can’t point to one short stretch like that.
Have your symptoms ever been much worse than they are now?
I don’t really know. I mean, some days feel worse than others, but I can’t say there was a time it was clearly much worse than now. It’s kind of hard for me to measure it like that.
Have you noticed any change in how bad your symptoms are now compared to when they first started?

I’m not sure I can really tell. It’s been going on long enough that I don’t have a clear before-and-now comparison. Some parts feel about the same, some days feel harder, but I haven’t really noticed a clear change from when it first started.
Have you ever had a period where you didn't experience any of these symptoms, like the mixed-up talking or hearing voices, for at least a couple of weeks?
I don’t think so. I mean, I can’t remember a couple weeks where it was just completely gone. Maybe some days are quieter than others, but I don’t know about a full stretch with none of it.
Have your symptoms ever been much worse than they are now?
I don’t really know how to say it different. I can’t point to a time when it was much worse than right now. It’s just been bad, and some days are harder, but I’m not sure about “much worse.”
Have you ever had a period of at least a month where these symptoms, such as the mixed-up talking and hearing voices, were present and caused significant distress or impairment?

Yes. It’s been more than a month, for sure. It’s caused real problems for me. I’ve missed shifts and lost cleaning work because people say they can’t rely on me or they can’t understand me. I stopped going to the mosque and family gatherings a lot too. And there have been times where it got unsafe enough that people had to call emergency help.
Have your symptoms, such as the mixed-up talking and hearing voices, been present for at least six months?
Yes. It’s been way more than six months. I’d say about two years and five months now, since after that brief detention over the misunderstanding at the building.
Have your symptoms, such as the mixed-up talking and hearing voices, been present continuously for at least a month at any point?
Yes, definitely. It wasn’t just a few days. It’s been going on steady for a long time—about two years and five months now, since after that brief detention from the misunderstanding at the building.
Have your symptoms, such as the mixed-up talking and hearing voices, been present for at least one year?
Yes, it’s been at least a year. Like I said, it’s been around two years and five months now, since after that brief detention over the misunderstanding at the building.
